lines.zh: 雪承不住我的重量，会塌下去。
lines.en: The snow cannot hold me; it gives way.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下一条深沟。
lines.en: Where I pass, a deep trench remains.

lines.zh: 我的步子比暴风雪还稳。
lines.en: My stride is steadier than the blizzard.

lines.zh: 冰壳在脚下裂开，像薄碗。
lines.en: Ice crust cracks under me like a thin bowl.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊走，风从侧面推我。
lines.en: I walk the ridge; wind pushes from the side.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过雪面，扬起白雾。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the snow into white mist.

lines.zh: 这么重的身体，走起来却不慢。
lines.en: This heavy body still moves fast.

lines.zh: 我在雪地里找没有结冰的坡。
lines.en: I look for slopes that have not frozen hard.

lines.zh: 毛上的霜，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Frost falls off my fur with every step.

lines.zh: 我踩过的雪，第二天还在。
lines.en: The snow I pressed stays marked the next day.

lines.zh: 山风认得我的气味。
lines.en: The mountain wind knows my scent.

lines.zh: 我绕过冰湖，那里的冰太薄。
lines.en: I skirt the frozen lake; its ice is too thin.

lines.zh: 雪埋到膝，我只当是浅水。
lines.en: Snow to my knees is only shallow water to me.

lines.zh: 我走路时尽量不回头看。
lines.en: I try not to look back while walking.

lines.zh: 我踏碎薄冰，冰下的水冒上来。
lines.en: I break the thin ice and water wells up under it.

lines.zh: 我边走边嗅，雪下有什么味道。
lines.en: I sniff as I walk; something smells under the snow.

lines.zh: 我趴在雪上，体温把雪化出个坑。
lines.en: I lie on snow and my warmth melts a hollow.

lines.zh: 冰晶在洞里发亮，我守着它。
lines.en: The ice crystal glows in its hollow; I guard it.

lines.zh: 冷对我不是问题，热才是。
lines.en: Cold is no trouble; heat is.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，呼出的气结成霜。
lines.en: I yawn and my breath turns to frost.

lines.zh: 风停在背风坡，我也停下来。
lines.en: Wind rests on the lee slope; so do I.

lines.zh: 我舔掉脚掌上的冰碴。
lines.en: I lick ice chips from my paws.

lines.zh: 雪落在毛上，很久才化。
lines.en: Snow on my fur takes long to melt.

lines.zh: 我听着山下的动静，很远也听得见。
lines.en: I listen downhill; even far sounds reach me.

lines.zh: 这具身体太大，转身要挪三步。
lines.en: This body is so large that turning takes three steps.

lines.zh: 我在等雪停，不急。
lines.en: I wait for the snow to stop; no hurry.

lines.zh: 洞里比外面暖一点，只一点。
lines.en: The hollow is warmer than outside, barely.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在岩壁上结了白。
lines.en: My breath leaves white on the rock wall.

lines.zh: 山里的夜很长，我睡得很浅。
lines.en: Mountain nights are long; I sleep lightly.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盘起来，垫在下巴下。
lines.en: I coil my tail and rest my chin on it.

lines.zh: 我用爪子刨开雪，露出底下的石头。
lines.en: I scrape the snow away and bare the stone beneath.

lines.zh: 我抬头看山口，云低得像屋顶。
lines.en: I look at the pass; the clouds hang low like a roof.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，是从低处来的。
lines.en: Your scent comes from far below.

lines.zh: 我不常见到两脚的小东西。
lines.en: I rarely see such small two-legged things.

lines.zh: 你站在我的影子里，那很危险。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow; that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛适应了雪光，你不必躲。
lines.en: My eyes are made for snow glare; do not hide.

lines.zh: 你穿得太薄，山会收走你。
lines.en: You are dressed too thin; the mountain will take you.

lines.zh: 你手里那把弓，射得穿我的皮吗。
lines.en: Will that bow pierce my hide?

lines.zh: 你呼吸的白气，比你先暴露。
lines.en: Your white breath gives you away first.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一块石头。
lines.en: I look down at you as at a stone.

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏，我听着新鲜。
lines.en: The rhythm of your walking is new to me.

lines.zh: 别摸冰晶，那不属于你。
lines.en: Do not touch the crystal; it is not yours.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，是雪太亮，不是你。
lines.en: I squint at the snow's glare, not at you.

lines.zh: 你退后时踩碎冰，我听见了。
lines.en: You broke ice stepping back; I heard it.

lines.zh: 这点伤，雪一盖就没事。
lines.en: Snow will cover this wound; it is nothing.

lines.zh: 你砍到毛，没到皮。
lines.en: You cut fur, not hide.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，山回了两声。
lines.en: I roared once; the mountain answered twice.

lines.zh: 这痛让我想起冰缝里的冬天。
lines.en: This pain recalls a winter in an ice crack.

lines.zh: 我退后，是因为血会引来别的。
lines.en: I back off because blood draws others.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，说明你有力气。
lines.en: You moved me; you have strength.

lines.zh: 皮太厚，你的刀卡了一下。
lines.en: My hide is thick; your blade caught.

lines.zh: 我不怕疼，我怕热。
lines.en: Pain does not frighten me; heat does.

lines.zh: 伤口冒白气，很快会冻住。
lines.en: The wound steams white and will soon freeze.

lines.zh: 再来几下，我就换个打法。
lines.en: A few more hits and I change my approach.

lines.zh: 你带的浆果，味道比雪好。
lines.en: Those berries you carry taste better than snow.

lines.zh: 我不吃人，但会闻你的干粮。
lines.en: I do not eat people, but I will sniff your rations.

lines.zh: 火堆让我想靠近，又不敢。
lines.en: The fire draws me close and keeps me back.

lines.zh: 苔藓从石头上刮下来，我才吃。
lines.en: I only eat moss scraped off stone.

lines.zh: 盐块递过来，我会舔很久。
lines.en: Offer a salt block and I will lick it a long while.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，树皮也算一顿。
lines.en: When hungry, tree bark counts as a meal.

lines.zh: 你别拿肉引我，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Do not wave meat; it does not interest me.

lines.zh: 冰晶不能吃，但我想守着它。
lines.en: The crystal is not food, yet I want to guard it.

lines.zh: 你把食物放远些，我才敢过来。
lines.en: Set the food farther off; then I dare approach.

lines.zh: 我鼻子灵，隔着雪也闻得到。
lines.en: My nose works through the snow.

lines.zh: 暖和的地方，比吃的更难得。
lines.en: Warmth is rarer than food up here.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是为了你，是为了那点火。
lines.en: I come near for the fire, not for you.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就把东西全吃了。
lines.en: Step away and I will eat all of it.

lines.zh: 一顿不够，我这样的身子要吃很多。
lines.en: One meal is not enough; a body like mine eats much.

lines.zh: 你把浆果撒在石头上，我盯着。
lines.en: You scatter berries on the stone, and I stare.

lines.zh: 我闻到熟肉，可我不吃那个。
lines.en: I smell cooked meat, but I do not eat that.

lines.zh: 被我蹭一下，你就滑出去很远。
lines.en: One brush from me sends you sliding far.

lines.zh: 我不是故意撞的，雪太滑。
lines.en: I did not mean to bump you; the snow is slick.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我腿上，像撞树。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my leg like a tree.

lines.zh: 让开些，我转身要占三丈。
lines.en: Give room; my turn takes three paces.

lines.zh: 我停下来，雪都被我推成堆。
lines.en: I stop and push the snow into a heap.

lines.zh: 堵住我回洞的路，你想清楚。
lines.en: Block my way into the den and think again.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫到你，风比尾巴先到。
lines.en: My tail caught you; the wind arrived first.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了半步，够你过了。
lines.en: I shift half a step; that is enough for you.

lines.zh: 别站在坡下，雪会跟着我下来。
lines.en: Do not stand below; snow follows me down.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你该知道我的分量。
lines.en: That bump should teach you my weight.

lines.zh: 雪山太大，找到同类不容易。
lines.en: The mountain is vast; finding my kind is hard.

lines.zh: 我闻过远处的气味，没追上。
lines.en: I smelled one far off and did not catch up.

lines.zh: 这身皮毛在雪里太显眼。
lines.en: This coat stands out too plainly in snow.

lines.zh: 冰晶是我唯一的伴。
lines.en: The ice crystal is my only companion.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫声会引来猎人。
lines.en: I do not call; a call would bring hunters.

lines.zh: 冬天太长，等不到就过去了。
lines.en: Winter is long; if no one comes, it passes.

lines.zh: 我守着洞，也许会有谁来。
lines.en: I guard the den; perhaps someone will come.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，多半是为了争这块地。
lines.en: When my kind meet, it is usually over this ground.

lines.zh: 我把最暖的位置留空着。
lines.en: I keep the warmest spot empty.

lines.zh: 雪化之前，我不打算离开。
lines.en: Before the snow melts, I do not plan to leave.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼，爪子太钝。
lines.en: I carry with my mouth; my claws are blunt.

lines.zh: 你掉的干粮，我闻了闻，没动。
lines.en: I sniffed your dropped rations and left them.

lines.zh: 这亮晶晶的东西，我叼回洞里。
lines.en: I carry this glittering thing back to the den.

lines.zh: 铁器太硬，我咬不住。
lines.en: Iron is too hard for my teeth.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块冰，当石头玩。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of ice and play with it like a stone.

lines.zh: 掉在雪里的东西，很难再找到。
lines.en: Things dropped in snow are hard to find again.

lines.zh: 我把东西埋起来，免得被风刮走。
lines.en: I bury things so the wind will not take them.

lines.zh: 你的箭，我一根根叼走了。
lines.en: I carried off your arrows one by one.

lines.zh: 我嘴里放不下更多了。
lines.en: My mouth will hold no more.

lines.zh: 捡来的都堆在洞口。
lines.en: Everything I pick up ends up at the den mouth.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的雪坡，我记住了。
lines.en: You trampled my snow slope; I remember.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是因为你身上的铁响了。
lines.en: I look up because your iron clinked.

lines.zh: 你朝冰晶走了一步，这就够了。
lines.en: You took one step toward the crystal; that is enough.

lines.zh: 山里的规矩：靠近洞口的都得走。
lines.en: Mountain rule: whoever nears the den must leave.

lines.zh: 我站起来，雪从我背上滑下去。
lines.en: I rise and snow slides off my back.

lines.zh: 你身上有火的味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of fire; I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你比其他人慢。
lines.en: I choose you; you are slower than the rest.

lines.zh: 你手里的镐，是来挖冰晶的吧。
lines.en: That pick means you came for the crystal.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变慢了，那是要动手。
lines.en: My breathing slowed; that means I will act.

lines.zh: 你退到崖边，选错了方向。
lines.en: You backed to the cliff; wrong direction.

lines.zh: 我在雪坡上跟着你，不费力。
lines.en: I follow you on the slope without effort.

lines.zh: 你跑不过我的四条腿。
lines.en: You cannot outrun my four legs.

lines.zh: 雪地会留下你的脚印。
lines.en: The snow keeps your prints.

lines.zh: 我绕到上风口，闻得更清楚。
lines.en: I circle upwind to smell you better.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我已经换了位置。
lines.en: You look back; I have already moved.

lines.zh: 我不急，你跑不远的。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you will not get far.

lines.zh: 你先看见影子，再看见我。
lines.en: You see the shadow first, then me.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘气，我也停下来。
lines.en: You stop to catch your breath; so do I.

lines.zh: 风从你那边来，带着汗味。
lines.en: Wind comes from your side, carrying sweat.

lines.zh: 你选了上坡，那最耗力气。
lines.en: You chose uphill; that drains you fastest.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，雪陷了半尺。
lines.en: One paw strike sinks the snow half a foot.

lines.zh: 爪子先到，牙齿随后。
lines.en: The claws arrive first; the teeth follow.

lines.zh: 你躲开了掌，没躲开肩。
lines.en: You dodged the paw, not the shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一口带着霜，伤口会发冷。
lines.en: This bite carries frost; the wound will chill.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，比挥爪更快。
lines.en: Charging is faster than swinging.

lines.zh: 冰息喷出去，你该往侧面跑。
lines.en: Frost breath out; you should run sideways.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的披风，扯了一下。
lines.en: I caught your cloak and pulled.

lines.zh: 掌落空时，地面裂了一条缝。
lines.en: My paw missed and split the ground.

lines.zh: 我不用全力，怕把洞震塌。
lines.en: I hold back so the den will not collapse.

lines.zh: 下一掌会从低处来。
lines.en: The next strike will come low.

lines.zh: 暴风雪里走出来一头巨兽。
lines.en: A great beast walks out of the blizzard.

lines.zh: 我在这片雪地睡了很久。
lines.en: I have slept on this snowfield a long while.

lines.zh: 冰晶亮了，说明我醒了。
lines.en: The crystal brightened; that means I woke.

lines.zh: 山脊上的雪突然塌了一角。
lines.en: A corner of the ridge suddenly gave way.

lines.zh: 脚印从崖下一直通到洞口。
lines.en: Tracks run from the cliff to the den mouth.

lines.zh: 冷风先到，我随后。
lines.en: The cold wind arrives first; I follow.

lines.zh: 这片雪原本没有主。
lines.en: This snowfield had no master before.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里挤出来，抖掉霜。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the ice crack and shake off frost.

lines.zh: 山下的村子又点起了火。
lines.en: The village below has lit its fires again.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把洞口封成白雾。
lines.en: My breath seals the den mouth in white.

lines.zh: 火碰到毛，焦味比痛更难受。
lines.en: Fire on my fur; the burnt smell bothers me more.

lines.zh: 从崖上摔下，雪替我垫了。
lines.en: I fell from the cliff and the snow cushioned me.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进鼻子，我拼命上岸。
lines.en: Icy water fills my nose; I fight for the bank.

lines.zh: 炸开的冰碴扎进背里。
lines.en: Blast-shattered ice cuts into my back.

lines.zh: 箭扎在肩上，像根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法让我毛上的霜化了一点。
lines.en: Magic melts a little frost from my coat.

lines.zh: 雪下得太久，苔藓都埋住了。
lines.en: The snow lay too long; even the moss is buried.

lines.zh: 雷打在山顶，我的毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the peak; my fur stood up.

lines.zh: 掉出山外，我抓不住任何雪。
lines.en: Falling past the mountain, I grasp no snow.
